label: Hook-owned project fee
summary: Add a disclosed project share inside the same effective total fee as the Programmable share.
requiredFacts: Selected total fee and the exact non-additive platform and project split
Project beneficiary, mutation rules, liability keys and claim behavior
Executed gross quote-side basis, rounding and partial-fill behavior
Public fee disclosure for every trading surface
requiredTests: Project share is zero at the 10-basis-point floor
Higher selected totals split without adding another 10 basis points
Beneficiary mutation cannot redirect the platform share
risks: Additive implementation would charge more than the selected total
Mutable recipients can create undisclosed payout control
